# Luminary Restaurant

> Luminary is an approachable fine-dining restaurant in Tempe, Arizona, offering a celestial-inspired tasting experience. Celestial in spirit, precise in execution: each dish is crafted with careful technique and sourced ingredients to reveal depth, contrast, and luminous discovery.

## Pages

- [Home](https://luminaryrestaurant.netlify.app/): Overview of Luminary, featured menu highlights, and reservations.
- [About](https://luminaryrestaurant.netlify.app/about): The story of Luminary and its chef philosophy.
- [Menu](https://luminaryrestaurant.netlify.app/menu): Appetizers, entrees, desserts, beverages, and cocktails.
- [Private Events](https://luminaryrestaurant.netlify.app/events): Private dining rooms and event hosting.
- [Reserve a Table](https://luminaryrestaurant.netlify.app/book): Book a reservation online.
